messages.author: 6033d3c0e7d242fa
messages.subject: Re: R package “Cardinal” Installation issues: Conflicting declaration ‘typedef struct Except_Frame_T*
parts:
Hello,

It appears you have broken 'assert.h' and/or 'except.h' headers in your '/usr/local/include' path. The errors are coming from these standard headers, which are included by a third-party library (pugixml) on which Cardinal depends, rather than any Cardinal code. Also considering you had compilation issues earlier that were fixed by reinstalling gcc, the error appears to originate from your local compilation environment, rather than Cardinal. I would maybe suggest finding a way to clean up your earlier install of gcc and then reinstalling your compilation toolchain cleanly before trying to reinstall Cardinal. I'm afraid I can't help you any more than that.

-Kylie
